races.race_name: Supporting Ayr Racecourse, The John Cocking Irish EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Love Rome
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to four winners, two of them placed in Group races; beaten nearly 8l but still displayed significant promise when third of five in Newmarket novice (7f, good to firm) won by a good prospect last month; needs to be taken very seriously.
runners.comment: Displayed clear promise when third of five (albeit well held) at Newmarket last month

runners.name: Astral Crown
runners.spotlight: 50,000gns yearling; seventh foal; half-brother to winners Lauderdale (French/KSA/Qatari 1m-10.5f including 2yo; RPR 102), Firelight (6f 2yo; 100) and Antiphon (5f-6f; 87); dam 1m4f winner (AW/Listed; 107), sister to 12.5f Listed winner Oh Beautiful; good market support will bring him into the equation.
runners.comment: Out of a 1m4f Listed winner; good market support will bring him into the equation

runners.name: Vega King
runners.spotlight: 68,000euros yearling; first foal; dam once-raced half-sister to winners Stormy Antarctic (1m/1m1f Group 2) and Al Johrah (Group-placed 5f 2yo), out of Listed-placed 1m/1m2f winner; with a good stable; no surprise if he features on debut.
runners.comment: Out of a half-sister to a Group 2 winner and represents a good stable; appeals on paper

runners.name: Mr Minz
runners.spotlight: Closely related to a fairly useful 6f 2yo winner; beaten about 11l when keeping-on third of six on last month's debut at Musselburgh (7f, good), showing only minor promise, but ought to have learnt from that experience.
runners.comment: Beaten about 11l when third of six on Musselburgh debut but can learn from that

runners.name: Weleyff
runners.spotlight: Cost 145,000gns as a yearling and is out of a fairly useful 7f AW winner; shaped well before fading into third of seven on debut at Beverley (7.4f, good) four weeks ago and will be a tough nut to crack if able to build on that performance here.
runners.comment: Shaped well before fading into third of seven on debut at Beverley four weeks ago

races.race_name: 25% Off Lunch At Western House Hotel Handicap

runners.name: Wee Mary
runners.spotlight: Only turf win came off a 7lb lower mark at Musselburgh in June (5f, good); two decent runs since then, goes well on fast ground and one to consider.
runners.comment: Only turf win was off 7lb higher at Musselburgh in June; two fair runs since; a possible

runners.name: Brazen Idol
runners.spotlight: All six wins, three on AW, have been over 6f; best run this season was when second over 5f at Ffos Las last month (good); chance on that run but this faster going not sure to suit.
runners.comment: All six wins have been at 6f; best run in 2026 when 2nd at Ffos Las (5f); a possible

runners.name: Falcon Queen
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish; five-race maiden; well beaten over 6f on both starts for Mike Smith; best watched for now.
runners.comment: Ex-Irish; 0-5; well beaten over 6f both starts for this yard; best watched for now

runners.name: Jm Jhingree
runners.spotlight: Back to form in first-time cheekpieces when winning a selling handicap at Hamilton last time (5f, good to firm); only 2lb higher so not out of it with headgear on again.
runners.comment: Won seller in first-time cheekpieces at Hamilton last time; conditions suit; not out of it

runners.name: Curious Rover
runners.spotlight: Won off an 11lb mark at Musselburgh last August (5f, good); hasn't run as well since and below-par over same C&D last time (good); dropped another 3lb so no surprise if he were to go well.
runners.comment: Won off 11lb higher mark last August; below-par last time; down another 3lb; could go well
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing Ltd And Partner

runners.name: Hi Lord
runners.spotlight: Won at Hamilton off 3lb lower in May (5f, good); close third over same C&D next time; each-way chance.
runners.comment: 5f Hamilton winner in May and close third over C&D next time; worth considering

runners.name: Woohoo
runners.spotlight: Three of her four wins last season (5f/6f) were on fast ground, so conditions suit here; creditable second over C&D last week (good); a leading chance.
runners.comment: Three of her four wins in 2025 were on fast ground; decent C&D 2nd last week; major chance

runners.name: Lion's House
runners.spotlight: Yet to win on turf, but is now 1lb lower than when winning at Newcastle in February (5f); could go well, although was beaten 10l here last time (6f, soft).
runners.comment: Yet to win on turf; 1lb below last winning AW mark; well beaten here last time (6f, soft)

runners.name: Thistle Nil
runners.spotlight: Off the mark in a maiden here in May (6f, soft; 200-1); not so good back in handicap company at Carlisle last time (6f, good); others stronger.
runners.comment: 200-1 winner of a 6f maiden here in May; not so good in h'cap latest; others stronger

runners.name: Our Absent Friends
runners.spotlight: Best at 5f, but all his wins have come on AW or good/soft ground on turf; fair third on fast ground at Catterick two runs back (5f) but well beaten after being slowly away and losing a shoe over C&D last week.
runners.comment: All wins over 5f, but suited by AW or good/slow going on turf; interesting if going eases

runners.name: King's Crown
runners.spotlight: Now 3lb lower than when winning on AW at Newcastle (5f) in January; fair form on turf last twice, latest when 2l fourth at Thirsk (5f, good); has won on fast ground; each-way chance.
runners.comment: Well treated on his best form and fair run when 2l fourth last time; each-way chance

races.race_name: Watch Racing TV Free For 31 Days Handicap

runners.name: Wee Dresser
runners.spotlight: Unexposed; well beaten on both starts in handicaps; best watched for now.
runners.comment: Unexposed; well beaten in her two runs in handicaps and probably best watched for now

runners.name: Azuinthejungle
runners.spotlight: Three wins last June/July, the third over 5f here (good to soft); just as effective over 6f on fast ground and AW; neck second at Hamilton (5f, good) on Saturday and one to consider.
runners.comment: Three wins last June/July; neck second at Hamilton on Saturday (5f); one to consider
runners.owner: D P Van Der Hoeven & D G Pryde

runners.name: Taygar
runners.spotlight: Has won four times, including twice here (5f/6f), but ideally suited by some give in the ground; proving hard to win with this season, although has run creditably on last four starts (on good to firm on first occasion); each-way chance.
runners.comment: Dual course winner; decent runs without winning last 4 starts, all at 6f; each-way chance

runners.name: White Ladder
runners.spotlight: Off the mark in a C&D handicap last week (good); has stiffer task with his penalty and was withdrawn on account of fast ground last month, but worth considering.
runners.comment: Off the mark in a C&D h'cap last week; stiffer task and faster ground here; could go well

runners.name: Doon The Glen
runners.spotlight: Only win in 19 turf runs was at Hamilton in June (6f, good to soft); close third to Jm Jhingree (runs in the 2.30) in a 5f Hamilton seller last month (good) and close fourth in a 5f handicap there on Saturday; each-way chance.
runners.comment: 1-19 on turf, his win at Hamilton in June; good fourth there on Saturday; place chance

runners.name: Whiskey Kisses
runners.spotlight: Ex-George Scott; eight-race maiden and yet to hit form for Mike Smith (well beaten over 7f here last week).
runners.comment: Ex-George Scott; eight-race maiden and yet to hit form for new trainer

runners.name: Water Of Leith
runners.spotlight: 12-time winner, latest on AW in March (6f); fair running-on third over 5f here last time (good; Woohoo, who runs in the 2.30, was second); contender back up in trip.
runners.comment: 12-time winner, latest on AW in March; decent third over 5f latest; 6f suits; contender
runners.owner: Adam Mills And Jonnie Delta Racing

runners.name: Royal Duke
runners.spotlight: All three wins have been over 5f on good ground, latest at Musselburgh last August; hasn't been in top form this term, best run when third at Musselburgh in June (5f); bit to prove, including his stamina.
runners.comment: All wins over 5f on good, latest last August; not been in top form; stamina to prove

runners.name: Thunderstorm Katie
runners.spotlight: Won five races last season, the first two over this C&D (good); handles this faster ground; runner-up in three of last four starts (sixth over 5f at Hamilton on Saturday); each-way chance.
runners.comment: Five wins in 2025 (two over C&D); acts on fast ground; in decent form; each-way chance

races.race_name: racingtv.com/freetrial Handicap

runners.name: Starliner
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in May (good to firm) and decent third at Hamilton later in the month (8.5f, good to firm); disappointing in two runs since, first-time cheekpieces latest (retained); could go well back on good to firm ground.
runners.comment: Goes really well on good to firm ground; below par last twice but could bounce back
runners.owner: David Orr & Miss L A Perratt

runners.name: Braes Of Doune
runners.spotlight: Two wins (7f/1m) in August 2024; best run last season was when second over C&D last May (good to firm); could bounce back from a below-par reappearance run last month.
runners.comment: Two wins in August 2024; good 2nd over C&D last May; below best on reappearance; contender

runners.name: Runninsonofagun
runners.spotlight: Won maiden claimer for Tony Mullins in August 2024 (1m, good); hasn't won since but a few fair runs for new yard, including when third at Carlisle in June (1m1f, soft); blinkers now tried; fast ground is a concern.
runners.comment: Won maiden claimer for Tony Mullins in 2024; best form for new yard on good/good to soft

runners.name: Millbuie
runners.spotlight: 27-race maiden; creditable third in a C&D classified event eight days ago (good); this is tougher.
runners.comment: 27-race maiden; creditable third in a C&D classified event last time; this is tougher
runners.owner: N J Dalgarno & W R Ellis

runners.name: Thats My Boy Luke
runners.spotlight: Two wins over 1m at Ripon last season (good/good to firm); a bit disappointing this term (4l fourth of seven at Pontefract latest) but on a good mark now.
runners.comment: Won twice over 1m at Ripon last term; a bit disappointing this term but on a good mark now

runners.name: Whiskey Pete
runners.spotlight: Only win in 23 runs was a 1m nursery at York in October 2023 for Ralph Beckett; badly out of form this season and cheekpieces now tried.
runners.comment: Only win in 23 was in 2023 for Ralph Beckett; out of form this year; headgear now tried

runners.name: Golden Valour
runners.spotlight: Veteran who has won three of his 58 races on turf, the latest over this trip at Musselburgh last September (good); has been a bit disappointing this season.
runners.comment: Veteran; record of 3-58 on turf, latest win last September; rather disappointing this term

runners.name: Eagles Dream
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish; 0-11; well beaten on stable debut at Carlisle nine days ago (1m1f, good) after nearly a year off but better can be expected today.
runners.comment: Ex-Irish; 0-11; well beaten on stable debut after absence but better expected this time

runners.name: Gressington
runners.spotlight: Dual turf winner in 2024 (6f/7.5f); has also won twice on the AW, most recently last December (7f), but rather out of form since and others are stronger.
runners.comment: Dual turf and AW winner, latest success in December; out of form since; others stronger
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing Ltd And Partner

races.race_name: Try Racing TV For Free Now Handicap

runners.name: Jkr Cobbler
runners.spotlight: Gained five of his nine wins over C&D, the latest eight days ago (good ground); still on workable mark under 4lb penalty and ought to be right in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: Five-time C&D winner, most recently last week; still on workable mark under penalty

runners.name: War Memorial
runners.spotlight: 2-4 since returned to turf in April, the latter win gained at Catterick (7f, good for firm) three weeks ago; effectively 6lb higher here if Conor Whiteley's reduced claim is considered but ought to go well again.
runners.comment: Won at Catterick three weeks ago and now 2-4 since returned to turf

runners.name: Monhammer
runners.spotlight: In the frame three consecutive times in recent weeks, most recently when fourth behind Jkr Cobbler over C&D (good) eight days ago, but remains without a win since spring 2024 and recent 2lb rise is not helpful.
runners.comment: In the frame three times in recent weeks but remains on a losing streak

runners.name: Imperial Guard
runners.spotlight: Has modest 1-22 strike-rate and is better known as a sprinter but kept on for respectable fifth at Thirsk (7f, good to firm) recently; drops in grade here and is well worth another crack at this trip; interesting.
runners.comment: Better known as sprinter but ran well over 7f recently; worth another try at this trip

runners.name: Penny Mountain
runners.spotlight: Just 1-22 but scores good marks for her consistency since 6f AW win in January; denied clear run before keeping on for fifth in recent C&D contest won by Jkr Cobbler; each-way claims at least.
runners.comment: Just 1-22 but scores good marks for her consistency since 6f AW win in January

runners.name: Due Respect
runners.spotlight: Belied 33-1 odds when fourth at Musselburgh (7f, good) three weeks ago and is now 2lb lower than for last summer's win at Redcar (7f, good to soft) but her overall profile remains unconvincing.
runners.comment: Belied 33-1 odds when fourth at Musselburgh last month but overall profile unconvincing

runners.name: Bantz
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on some of last year's form for Gemma Tutty but left that stable after some disappointing runs in the autumn and there has been no upturn after three starts for new trainer this year.
runners.comment: Out of form for new stable this year (three runs)

runners.name: Tap Dancer
runners.spotlight: Yet to strike form after four runs for new stable this year (1m-1m2f) and her only win was gained over 1m2f on heavy ground; continues to slip down the weights but drops back to 7f with quite a bit to prove.
runners.comment: Yet to strike form for new stable this year; drops back to 7f with quite a bit to prove

runners.name: Ramon Di Loria
runners.spotlight: Safely held on consecutive 6f starts this spring but placed twice since returned to 7f, latterly in C&D (good) contest won by Jkr Cobbler three weeks ago; 2lb higher today but probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: Placed twice since returned to 7f, latterly over C&D eight days ago; in the mix again

races.race_name: Racing TV Handicap

runners.name: Pearl Eye
runners.spotlight: Came good for Jim Goldie at third attempt, in refitted cheekpieces at Hamilton last month, and bettered that form when close third in competitive race at York (also 1m1f, good) soon afterwards; not quite at same level over the extended 1m2f at York last time but still a major player here.
runners.comment: Placed in competitive race at York since last month's Hamilton win; major player

runners.name: Spiritoftheblues
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage filly who kept on for clear second behind unexposed rival on last month's handicap debut at Hamilton (8.3f, good); moves back up in trip and competes off same mark here; commands respect.
runners.comment: Kept on for clear second on last month's handicap debut; commands respect off same mark

runners.name: Light The Night Up
runners.spotlight: Safely held over 7f recently and now 0-7 but made the frame on consecutive 8.3f starts at Nottingham in April, and the dam's side of her pedigree suggests she's well worth a crack at this new trip.
runners.comment: Safely held over 7f last time but has form over 8.3 previously; tries a new trip today

runners.name: Pol Roger
runners.spotlight: Yet to add to his two C&D wins in spring 2024 but got back in the groove with two placed runs last month, the latter in Class 4 C&D contest; ought to pose a potent threat at this lower level.
runners.comment: Back in the groove with two placed runs last month, the latter in Class 4 C&D contest

runners.name: Polygram
runners.spotlight: 0-14 overall but has performed respectably for new stable this year, most recently when fourth at Carlisle (1m3f, good to soft) last month; continues to edge down the weights and ought to be suited by the reduced emphasis on stamina here; not out of this.
runners.comment: 0-14 overall but has performed respectably for new yard this year; not out of this

races.race_name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Simple Star
runners.spotlight: Took step back in right direction when second of five at Musselburgh (2m, good) last month but was unable to lay a glove on Cascade Hall and will need to build on that performance here.
runners.comment: Unable to lay a glove on Cascade Hall when second at Musselburgh last month

runners.name: Cascade Hall
runners.spotlight: Two wins this spring, latterly when making all to score by over 6l at Musselburgh (2m, good) last month; safely held when making the frame on next two outings (2m/2m1f) but still enters calculations.
runners.comment: Two wins this springs (1m7f/2m); safely held twice since but still enters calculations

runners.name: Annandale
runners.spotlight: Gained three of his nine wins over this C&D and gave good account when staying-on third over C&D (good) a week ago; still on the same workable mark and has another big role to play.
runners.comment: Three-time C&D winner who gave good account when staying-on third over C&D a week ago

runners.name: Inappropriate
runners.spotlight: Placed over hurdles this season and was third (albeit no match for wide-margin winner) in Cumberland Plate at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) when back on the Flat for new stable last month; respected off same mark in this easier race.
runners.comment: Placed in Cumberland Plate when back on the Flat for recent stable debut; respected

runners.name: Glasses Up
runners.spotlight: Long in the tooth now and needs to better his recent efforts but was close third off 4lb higher at Hamilton (1m1f, good to firm) in May and is probably better suited by today's trip; can't rule out.
runners.comment: Needs to better recent efforts but this well-handicapped veteran can't be ruled out

runners.name: Simply Ruby
runners.spotlight: Made winning handicap debut for Ed Walker at Ffos Las (1m4f, soft) last summer but was sold for 13,000gns after a lesser effort in September and this stable debut comes after a 292-day break; market may guide.
runners.comment: Won on soft ground last summer but this stable debut comes after a layoff

races.race_name: Racing To School Reaches 250,000 Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.name: Miss Denver
runners.spotlight: Maiden who is not living up to her pedigree but seemed to enjoy front-running role and ran best race yet when clear second of ten in Worcester handicap chase (2m, good) 12 days ago; must be considered after that effort.
runners.comment: Seemed to enjoy front-runner role and ran best race yet when clear second at Worcester

runners.name: Gore Point
runners.spotlight: Probably fortunate when left clear to score at Stratford (2m3f, good to firm) last month but readily followed up in four-runner C&D (good) contest ten days ago and is evidently in prime form.
runners.comment: Won readily over C&D ten days ago and now bids for a hat-trick

runners.name: Manyana Blue
runners.spotlight: Made all in mares' maiden hurdle here (2m1f, good) last summer and came second on her next three appearances; absent since October but her 12lb weight-for-age allowance will be handy on this chasing debut.
runners.comment: Hurdle winner here last summer; makes chase debut after break but with 12lb 4yo allowance

races.race_name: Sun Racing The Home Of Racing Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: God Of Fire
runners.spotlight: Useful on the Flat at his best and made the frame in two maiden hurdles in April 2025 (both 2m, good); this is his first run since and he doesn't set a daunting form standard but, nevertheless, he's a big player.
runners.comment: Absent since making the frame in two maiden hurdles in Apri 2025; still a big player

runners.name: Jasper Glory
runners.spotlight: Bought for £4,000 after finishing third of nine in good-ground Irish point on debut in April; not an easy one to weigh up but has joined a top stable for rules career; tongue-tie on; market helpful.
runners.comment: Bought for £4,000 after Irish point third in April; with top yard for rules career

runners.name: Maria Mes
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in both bumpers last year but her fourth of six over hurdles at Fontwell (2m3f, good) last month was more encouraging and further progress is possible.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in both bumpers but last month's hurdle debut was more encouraging

runners.name: Little Twig
runners.spotlight: Out of an unraced sister to high-class chaser Nacarat; made low-key rules debut when well-held fourth at Bangor (2m3f, good) last month but was placed in an Irish point in May and is open to improvement.
runners.comment: Placed in an Irish point; made low-key rules debut but is open to improvement

races.race_name: Racing Club Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Ugo Bingo
runners.spotlight: Two creditable efforts since returning from a short break, latest when a close fourth over 2m1f here last month off this mark; stays this far and enters calculations.
runners.comment: Two creditable runs since returning from a break, latest when a close fourth; respected.

runners.name: Privilege
runners.spotlight: 18-race maiden; twice a runner-up over C&D last summer; failed to hit those heights since but shaped with more encouragement on last month's return over C&D, as though the run was needed, and remains on a competitive mark if able to build on that effort.
runners.comment: 18-race maiden but twice C&D runner-up; encouraging return and has a competitive mark.

runners.name: Coup De Gold
runners.spotlight: Returned from a break to register a third career success here (2m1f, good) last month, under Eleanor Williams; remains competitively treated with 3lb rise and capable of another bold showing if reproducing that performance.
runners.comment: C&D winner latest; 3lb higher but remains well treated and can go close.

runners.name: Raffles Nobu
runners.spotlight: Still chasing a first British success since his French 2023 hurdle win and, while he has posted a few placed efforts, he has failed to quite see out his races over trips beyond 2m; another 3lb lower but needs to raise his game.
runners.comment: French hurdle winner seeking a British success; place claims again off another 3lb lower.

runners.name: Hawa Jumeirah
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner (1m2f/1m4f) who had shown little over hurdles until stepped up in trip when a near 6l third behind Saucats over C&D ten days ago; meets that rival on 4lb better terms and enters calculations if building on that performance.
runners.comment: Dual Flat winner; improved over C&D latest and now 4lb better with Saucats; considered.

runners.name: Renoir
runners.spotlight: Well treated on peak form but has struggled since returning from wind surgery and finished a well-beaten last of three over 3m2f here in May when he may not have stayed; this much shorter trip and first-time blinkers may help but he arrives with plenty to prove.
runners.comment: Well treated on his best but below par since wind surgery; blinkers need to spark revival.

runners.name: Saucats
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 25th attempt with a comfortable C&D success ten days ago; a 3lb rise looks fair and a repeat would make him a major player, though his overall profile remains patchy.
runners.comment: C&D winner ten days ago; 3lb rise fair but patchy profile remains a concern.

runners.name: Peace Motivator
runners.spotlight: Has struggled outside bumpers; pulled up twice before trailing home last of eight most recently; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Has struggled for outside bumpers; pulled up twice before tailed off latest

runners.name: Bowling Shane
runners.spotlight: Kept on for third on handicap hurdle debut at Ffos Las (2m, good) in May but may not have stayed 2m4f when below that form last month; tongue-tie is fitted and this drop back in trip could see him in a better light.
runners.comment: May not have stayed the 2m4f latest; drop in trip and tongue-tie may see him bounce back.

runners.name: Anothermanicmonday
runners.spotlight: Best effort when switched to a left-handed track for a 2m5f handicap at Fontwell in May last time and, although this drop back in trip is not an obvious plus, he remains unexposed and open to improvement.
runners.comment: Best effort at Fontwell latest; drop in trip not ideal but he remains unexposed.

runners.name: Get The Value
runners.spotlight: Completed a spring double last year off 8lb higher; struggled for form after returning in December from a break but fared better when back to front-running tactics at Stratford (extended 2m2f; good to firm) a fortnight ago and a repeat of that effort would put him in the mix.
runners.comment: Dual hurdle winner; back to some form latest and respected if repeating that effort.

runners.name: Sam's Amour
runners.spotlight: Triple hurdle winner who has dropped to an attractive mark but for good reason; tailed off over further here last month and, although this shorter trip is a plus, she has plenty to prove.
runners.comment: Triple hurdle winner who needs a return to some form, the shorter trip is a plus

races.race_name: Par Inn Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.name: Limerick Leader
runners.spotlight: Only one win from 18 runs over fences but he tends to run his race and has plenty of placed efforts to his name; below par when third off this mark over C&D last month and now wears a refitted tongue-tie; could quickly return to form.
runners.comment: Only one chase win but fairly reliable; tongue-tie refitted after below par latest.

runners.name: Ellerton
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-4 for this stable when winning a 2m1f handicap hurdle here in May and followed that with a respectable second off 5lb higher back here a fortnight later; has plenty in his favour on this chase debut.
runners.comment: Solid second latest off this mark and looks to have plenty in his favour on chase debut.

runners.name: The Gypsy Davey
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner who has been more miss than hit since scoring in May last year; recent hurdle run in a first-time visor (retained) offered little encouragement, but he returns to fences off a handy mark; needs to rediscover his spark.
runners.comment: Dual chase winner but more miss than hit since May win; returns to fences off handy mark.

runners.name: It's A Breeze
runners.spotlight: 13-race maiden, including three runs over fences, but showed more when travelling well for a long way last time, failing to stay 3m2f; needs to build on that and the drop back in trip is a plus; usually claimer ridden but not today.
runners.comment: 13-race maiden; better latest, when not staying 3m2f, and drop in trip should suit.

races.race_name: William Hill Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.name: Slaney Opera
runners.spotlight: Encouraging first two efforts for this stable before a lesser run prompted wind surgery; got back on track to some extent at Bangor (3m, good) last month and, while more is needed, he's likely to have a say.
runners.comment: Back on track following wind surgery latest; more is needed but he could have a say.

runners.name: Muskerry Rock
runners.spotlight: Irish hunter chase winner who has gone very close on both starts for this stable, beaten a neck at Fontwell (3m2f, good) and by a short head at Market Rasen (2m7f, good) nine days later; up in class but looks to have a strong chance of doubling his chase tally.
runners.comment: Irish hunter chase winner; twice narrowly denied for new yard and has strong claims.

runners.name: Belgarum
runners.spotlight: Showed the benefit of a fourth wind operation when winning over hurdles at Fontwell (2m3f, good) in May and only narrowly denied by an in-form Skelton horse off 3lb higher two weeks later; below par since but he returns to fences on a competitive mark.
runners.comment: Won after fourth wind op; below par latest but reverts to fences on a competitive mark.

runners.name: Presentandcounting
runners.spotlight: Good-ground specialist with nine chase wins to his name, latest off 2lb higher in July last year; solid front-running third at Bangor (2m4f, good) 17 days ago after a break and he holds leading claims.
runners.comment: Nine chase wins; solid Bangor third latest back from a break and leading claims.

runners.name: Balkardy
runners.spotlight: Multiple hurdle/chase winner but he's lost his way since a 2m4f success at Ffos Las (good to soft) last June and has offered little in three runs this season; well treated on his best form but with plenty to prove.
runners.comment: Multiple winner but of form since last June's win; well treated yet has much to prove.

races.race_name: Savanna Stevens Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 2 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Park Hall
runners.spotlight: £27,000 purchase after winning her sole Irish point in May and made the perfect start for her new stable when landing a C&D bumper last month (first-time hood; retained); had plenty in hand and she's a leading contender under her penalty.
runners.comment: Irish point winner; comfortable C&D bumper winner on stable debut; sets a fair standard.

runners.name: Thepassingtyphoon
runners.spotlight: Justified support when making a winning C&D debut (good to soft) in June, keeping on well despite showing signs of inexperience; more on his plate under a penalty but he's entitled to improve; should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Won C&D bumper on debut despite inexperience; carries a penalty but open to improvement.

runners.name: Manussa Pedlar
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to winners Bagheera Ginge (2m2f-3m2f hurdle/chase) and Champ Is Real (3m chase); makes debut and bred to have a future but likely one for further down the line.
runners.comment: Related to winners but likely one for further down the line when tackling longer trips.
runners.owner: J L Lightfoot- D V Gardner

runners.name: Peggy Swift
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to useful winners Perfect Attitude (point/2m hurdle), Dragon Bones (bumper/2m4f-3m hurdle) and Flawless Escape (bumper/2m4f hurdle); pedigree offers encouragement but only of interest if attracting support.
runners.comment: Well-bred newcomer; pedigree offers encouragement but market may prove the best guide.

runners.name: Company Charge
runners.spotlight: £5,000 purchase as a 3yo; half-brother to winners Lofgren (useful 2m-3m1f hurdle/chase) and Gatacre Street (2m7f chase); newcomer from a respected stable and worth monitoring in the market.
runners.comment: Related to winners; newcomer from a respected stable and worth monitoring in the market.

runners.name: Someboy For Oneboy
runners.spotlight: Second foal; out of an unraced dam closely related to winners Urbanist (2m-3m hurdle/chase) and Lilting Verse (bumper/2m5f hurdle/2m7f chase), likely to benefit from this debut and looks one for the longer term.
runners.comment: Nicely bred newcomer who should improve for this debut and looks one for the longer term.

runners.name: Bath Taverness
runners.spotlight: Hinted at ability in two bumpers last season, most recently when staying on into fifth at Chepstow in April; likely to be seen in a better light over hurdles, particularly when tackling longer trips.
runners.comment: Hinted at ability in bumpers and looks one for hurdles over longer trips in due course.

runners.name: Ocean Rose
runners.spotlight: Showed more when a 9l sixth of seven at Stratford (2m, good to firm) on second start, though the form is open to question in a steadily run race; improvement is still required.
runners.comment: Improved on debut latest, albeit in a steadily run contest; needs to step up again.

runners.name: Savanna Storm
runners.spotlight: Well-related 4yo who was sent off 8-1 for his debut at Fontwell in May but finished a well-beaten seventh of nine; likely to have benefited from the run though much more is needed.
runners.comment: Well-related 4yo; should improve for debut but needs to take a major step forward.

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden

runners.name: Oklahoma
runners.spotlight: Regally-bred Wootton Bassett colt was sent off 6-1 on debut at the Curragh 16 days ago and found just stablemate Giant Sequoia too good; pulled nicely clear of the third that day and likely to improve plenty for that initial experience; preferred by Lordan; the one to beat.
runners.comment: Promising introduction at the Curragh, preferred by Lordan, the one to beat
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Capability Brown
runners.spotlight: Dubawi colt; half-brother to winners Saxon Warrior (1m inc 2yo/2,000 Guineas; RPR 122), Drumroll (1m/1m2f inc Group 3; 110), More Beautiful (Listed-placed 5f 2yo; 102) and Pavlenko (7f; 91); dam 6f/7f 2yo winner (inc Group 1; 114); top pedigree but Lordan prefers stablemate.
runners.comment: Dubawi gelding, half-brother to top class Saxon Warrior, Lordan prefers stablemate
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: City Of Dubai
runners.spotlight: Mehmas colt; E260,000 yearling; half-brother to winners Bear Story (1m-10.6f AW inc 2yo/Group 3/Australia; RPR 110) and Slieve Bearnagh (7f-1m2f Flat, 71; 2m/2m1f hurdle); dam 1m2f winner (96), half-sister to HK/Singapore 1m-1m2f Group 1 winner Dunboyne Express; respected source and lots of appeal on paper.
runners.comment: E260,000 Mehmas colt, half-brother to Group 3 winner, plenty of appeal on paper

runners.name: Francillon
runners.spotlight: Frankel colt; dam 6f-8.5f winner (inc 2yo/US Grade 1; RPR 110), sister to 6f 2yo Group 3 winner Sacred Bridge, closely related to 1m2f Listed winner Crossed Baton, out of 9.4f/1m2f winner from fine family; attractive pedigree and yard in red-hot form.
runners.comment: Frankel colt, dam US Grade 1 winner, attractive pedigree, yard in red-hot form

runners.name: Green Dreamer
runners.spotlight: Churchill colt; E40,000 yearling; half-brother to winners Spirit Of Saxony (7f AW; RPR 89), Coolmeen Vega (Spanish 7.5f-8.5f) and Pure Circle (Italian 6f); dam unraced half-sister to 5f Group 3 winner Jessica's Dream (dam of 1m Group 1 winner Havana Gold); looks yard's second string on rider arrangements.
runners.comment: E40,000 Churchill colt, dam unraced, looks yard's second string

runners.name: Zarak Pasha
runners.spotlight: Zarak colt; E65,000 yearling; bought for 75,000gns at the Breeze Ups in April; unraced dam closely related to Australian 1m2f Listed winner Astronomos, half-sister to Gold Cup winner Courage Mon Ami; preferred by Browne-McMonagle.
runners.comment: Zarak colt, 75,000gns breeze up buy, dam unraced, preferred by McMonagle

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Race

runners.name: Mai Dahlia
runners.spotlight: Promise on debut at Naas (1m, good) and second time out at Fairyhouse (1m2f, good); bolted up in a fillies' maiden back at Naas (1m, good) on latest, earning a rating of 88; that could underestimate her, she's well bred and gets weight from the boys; interesting.
runners.comment: Promise first two starts, bolted up at Naas latest, rating of 88 might underestimate her

runners.name: Straight Up
runners.spotlight: Won on debut at Listowel last September (7f, heavy); two of three subsequent starts have come in Group 3s over 1m at Newmarket (sixth of 7 beaten 3.75l) and on latest in first-time hood (retained) over 1m2f at Leopardstown (last of 5 beaten 5.5l); rated 99, so obvious chance on the figures in this lesser race.
runners.comment: Maiden winner, rated 99, obvious chance on the figures down in grade
runners.owner: Flaxman Stables, Mrs Magnier, M Tabor, D Smith

runners.name: Res Ipsa
runners.spotlight: Disappointed when a beaten favourite on sole start at two but much better form this year; close second over this C&D (good) on return in May; justified short odds to win an ordinary maiden at Limerick by 6l on latest (1m, good); rated 89 so a fair bit to find with Straight Up, but going the right way and his yard remains in terrific form.
runners.comment: Off the mark at Limerick latest, a bit to find but going the right way for in form yard

runners.name: Loughrea
runners.spotlight: Built on promise of first two starts to get off the mark in a Curragh maiden (1m, good) 17 days ago; awarded an official rating of 86, so is not well treated by these race conditions; not totally discounted, but others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Rated 86 after Curragh maiden win, not well treated by race conditions, others preferred

runners.name: Bold Style
runners.spotlight: AW maiden winner and Listed second for Charlie Appleby last year; didn't cut much ice in three starts at Meydan for Bhupat Seemar and now makes debut for Andy Slattery; yard looks to have stronger claims with Loughrea, so likely best watched.
runners.comment: AW maiden winner, no impact last three starts at Meydan, watch on stable debut

races.race_name: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Handicap

runners.name: Glitter And Glory
runners.spotlight: Consistent filly rarely runs a bad race; won a maiden at Dundalk in March; not beaten far in Curragh handicap in May; 0.5l behind Johnny Soda in rated race at Leopardstown latest and weighted to turn that around now; big chance.
runners.comment: Consistent filly, weighted to turn recent form with Johnny Soda around, big chance

runners.name: Dervo Annie
runners.spotlight: All three handicap runs on good ground have been fine efforts; runner up at Down Royal (7f), won at Fairyhouse (6f, good) and kept on for a 0.5l second back there over 7f on latest; nudged up another 3lb and this is harder, but the step up to 1m could eke out more improvement, so not discounted.
runners.comment: Form figures of 212 in good ground handicaps, could improve for step up to 1m

runners.name: Red Autumn
runners.spotlight: Won a Bellewstown maiden last year (1m, good); okay return in the Madrid at Naas (7f, soft) in March; not as good upped to 1m1f on latest at Leopardstown (soft); drops back in trip now and visor goes on; could rebound on this sounder surface.
runners.comment: Won maiden on good, below par on soft latest, visor on, could rebound on better ground

runners.name: Chirac
runners.spotlight: Won off 13lb lower at Gowran (7f, soft) in April; let backers down when beaten favourite at Leopardstown (7f, sft-hvy) but bounced back last time when a good second at Cork (1m, good); raised 2lb for that and this is a deeper race, so more needed.
runners.comment: Won off 13lb lower in April, back to form at Cork latest, this a deeper race, needs more

runners.name: Golddream
runners.spotlight: Dundalk maiden winner; 0-2 on turf; over 4.25l behind Johnny Soda (and Glitter And Glory) in rated race at Leopardstown on latest; 7lb swing could enable him to close that gap on his handicap debut.
runners.comment: Dundalk maiden winner, 7lb swing for 4.25l defeat behind Johnny Soda last time

runners.name: Vishaya
runners.spotlight: Definite promise in maidens on the AW over 7f-1m and on latest at Naas (1m, good); could be on a decent mark for her first handicap and worth checking in the market.
runners.comment: Handicap debutante, promise in AW and turf maidens, worth a market check

runners.name: Johnny Soda
runners.spotlight: Enjoying a good season with wins in handicap at Cork (1m, soft) in May and a rated race at Leopardstown (1m, good) last month; beat Glitter And Glory by half a length the last day and 5lb worse off here, so may not uphold that form.
runners.comment: Won twice this year, beat Glitter And Glory in rated race latest, worse off at weights now

runners.name: Casamorati
runners.spotlight: Didn't show a whole lot in maidens at 7f-9.5f on varying ground; gelded after mid-field finish at Gowran in May and now makes handicap debut; yard also runs Vishaya; the market can guide.
runners.comment: Handicap debutant, gelded since last run, yard also runs Vishaya, market can guide

races.race_name: Killarney Glamping Handicap

runners.name: Earls
runners.spotlight: Wonderfully durable handicapper with 11 wins to his name, the latest being on his favoured soft ground at Roscommon in September; returned to form at that track two starts back, where he handled good ground, and fine run at Limerick (yielding) last month when narrowly beaten by an in-form 3yo; easier ground would be ideal, but still the one to beat.
runners.comment: Wonderfully durable handicapper with 11 wins; two good efforts in defeat lately

runners.name: Molto Amichi
runners.spotlight: Maiden has finished second five times, twice at Ballinrobe and three times at Leopardstown; on second start of the season, was backed at latter venue when front-running second over 1m1f; that was on soft to heavy, but he's fine on good; doesn't have to lead, but mightn't be much competition for it here.
runners.comment: Second five times, including over 1m1f at Leopardstown latest when tried to make all

runners.name: Quatre Bras
runners.spotlight: Three wins from eight AW starts, but 0-20 on turf; did well at Dundalk over the winter and carried that form through to soft-ground contests in the spring; second over 7f at Naas and fourth over 1m2f at Leopardstown in April (strong form); not so good lately; likes to come from off the pace.
runners.comment: Second at Naas in March, fourth at Leopardstown in April (strong form); not so good lately

runners.name: Marta's Prince
runners.spotlight: Won in Poland at two and over 1m1f in France last year; picked up for 9,000 euros in November; 80-1, never a factor over 10.5f on Irish debut at Roscommon.
runners.comment: Won in Poland at two and over 1m1f in France last year; never a factor on Irish debut

runners.name: Howyoulikethat
runners.spotlight: Latest of five wins was in the 2023 renewal of this event, after which he ran well in a Group 3 at Leopardstown and a Listed contest over C&D; not the same force nowadays and has come down a good bit in the ratings; was still capable of good form last year; not at his best on AW in the spring and back from a break here.
runners.comment: Latest of five wins was in the 2023 renewal of this event;  not the same force nowadays
runners.owner: Just The Two Of Us Partnership

runners.name: Louiescall
runners.spotlight: Had placed form over 6f/7f at three, but sole win came when making all over 1m7f in amateur riders' handicap at Leopardstown last summer; twice runner-up in maiden hurdles as well; this will be too sharp a test on first run since October.
runners.comment: Sole win came when made all over 1m7f and twice second over hurdles; trip looks too sharp

runners.name: Grey Leader
runners.spotlight: Five wins for Joe Murphy, latest of them over 1m1f at Tipperary in October; big prices and has shown little in four starts for this yard; mark tumbling, but prefers it soft and will be of more interest when the rain returns.
runners.comment: Five wins for Joe Murphy; has shown little for this yard and prefers softer ground

runners.name: American Lawyer
runners.spotlight: Often made the frame in France, but just a 1m maiden win to his name; picked up out of a claimer in August, a frequent source of recruits to this yard; almost always wore hood/tongue-tie combination; goes without any aids here; long absence and surprise if he's ready to be involved.
runners.comment: Often made the frame in France, but just a 1m maiden win to his name; long absence

races.race_name: Kerry Publicans Summer Race Day Fillies Maiden

runners.name: Vauntingly
runners.spotlight: Rated 77 after three starts at 1m-9.5f; got to within 4.5l of the smart Sparan Nua on second start at Gowran (9.5f, good); found just one too good when ridden positively in Down Royal maiden on latest (10.5f, soft); may be more to come at this longer trip and this track could suit; chance.
runners.comment: Promise all three starts and rated 77, good second latest, this track could suit, chance

runners.name: White Sand Beach
runners.spotlight: 0-8 and rated 82; all starts over 1m this season; 1.75l third in Naas maiden on seasonal return on soft; no impact in two stakes races and a handicap subsequently, but back on song in first time blinkers (retained) returned to maiden company at Naas (1m, good); worth a go at this trip and should go well again.
runners.comment: Placed in both maiden runs this season at 1m, worth a go at this trip, go well again
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Benaki
runners.spotlight: Promising start when runner up on debut at Limerick (1m4f, yielding); upset in the stalls before running moderately on soft to heavy at Cork (1m4f); could do better back on a sounder surface, but more needed.
runners.comment: Promising debut, upset in stalls and struggled on heavy latest, ground here more suitable

runners.name: Cite Florale
runners.spotlight: Modest debut on AW last year, but much better efforts this season in maidens at Naas (10.5f, good) and back at Dundalk (1m4f) on latest; rated 74 so still a fair bit to find to win, but definite place chance.
runners.comment: Promise in last two maidens, rated 74 so needs more to win but place shout

runners.name: Hey Stella
runners.spotlight: Camelot filly; half-sister to 7f 2yo winner Promo Queen (RPR 72); dam 1m/1m2f AW winner (RPR 73), half-sister to winners Erhaaf (1m2f), Ruzeiz (French 1m3f) and Jasaara (1m2f), out of unraced sister to Arc winner Sakhee; yard in red-hot form; check market.
runners.comment: Camelot filly, dam 1m/1m2f AW winner, yard in red hot form, check the market

runners.name: Phlox
runners.spotlight: Sent off at 10-1 on debut at Leopardstown (1m5f, gd-fm) and kept on well for a 5.25l fifth of 10; not sure this drop in trip will suit on that evidence, but yard continues in terrific form, so can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Kept on well over 1m5f on debut, shorter trip a query but yard flying so not ruled out
runners.owner: Barnane Stud & Hollywood Stud Ireland Limited

runners.name: Sea Of The Celts
runners.spotlight: Sea The Stars filly; 525,000gns yearling; dam Group-placed 1m4f-1m6f winner (RPR 108), half-sister to winners Prince Of Arran (1m4f Australian Group 3/Melbourne Cup runner-up) and Souter (useful 1m/8.5f); Irish Oaks entry from respected source and makes plenty of appeal on paper.
runners.comment: 525,000gns Sea The Stars filly, dam group placed, plenty of appeal on paper

runners.name: Guinelot
runners.spotlight: 28-1 but far from disgraced on debut at Down Royal (10.5f, soft); open to improvement over this slightly longer trip and dam acted on good ground, so should handle conditions.
runners.comment: Not disgraced on debut, may improve for this longer trip, should handle better ground

runners.name: De Vega Queen
runners.spotlight: Both runs on soft ground; kept on nicely enough on debut at Gowran (9.5f); another solid effort upped to 1m4f at Cork latest when she had Benaki over 5l behind; pedigree suggests she could take another step forward on this quicker ground.
runners.comment: Promise both starts on soft, pedigree suggests quicker ground could suit

runners.name: Soigne
runners.spotlight: No impact at big odds in maidens at Naas and Fairyhouse; will qualify for handicaps after this.
runners.comment: No impact in maidens at Naas and Fairyhouse, handicaps beckon after this

runners.name: Invincible Destiny
runners.spotlight: Huge odds and well beaten in both starts; seems safe to rule out.
runners.comment: Huge odds and no show in both starts, seems safe to rule out

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden

runners.name: Camino Lad
runners.spotlight: Third to a smart stablemate over 1m at Limerick (Highwayman well in arrears) and strong at the finish when second over 9.5f at Ballinrobe (third won handicap off 72 since); bred to stay and will take beating.
runners.comment: Finished well when second over 9.5f at Ballinrobe; bred to stay and will take beating.

runners.name: Loch Gamhna
runners.spotlight: Third to Causeway (unbeaten in four starts since, including a Group 2 at Royal Ascot) in 7f Curragh maiden last year; hasn't built on that; mark was put back up 5lb after fair run in valuable event at Gowran last month; all his form is with an ease and scratched because of fast ground last time; steps up in trip by two furlongs.
runners.comment: Third to the talented Causeway in 7f Curragh maiden last year, but hasn't built on that

runners.name: Mr Ballynonty
runners.spotlight: Third to a pair of mid-80s rivals over 1m2f at Navan, beaten 5l having travelled well; looked a non-stayer over 1m4f last time; headgear.
runners.comment: Creditable third over 1m2f at Navan, looked a non-stayer over 1m4f last time; headgear

runners.name: Highwayman
runners.spotlight: The fact that he was 250-1 for his latest run over 1m at Naas tells you how little he had accomplished prior to that; came from the rear and was going on well in the final furlong when beaten 4.5l; mark looks in the right ballpark on that evidence and half-brother won over this trip in France.
runners.comment: Stayed on well to be beaten 4.5l over 1m at Naas; half-brother won over his trip in France

runners.name: Yogini
runners.spotlight: Superbly bred (sibling of three Group 1 winners); 14s for 1m4f maiden at Dundalk, green and off the bridle a long way out, beaten 11l by winner who was placed in a Royal Ascot handicap next time; blinkers added.
runners.comment: Green and off the bridle a long way out when beaten 11l in AW maiden over 1m4f; blinkers

runners.name: Go Kodi
runners.spotlight: Second foal of unraced half-sister to winners Primo Lady (5f 2yo Listed), Zhiggy's Stardust (6f) and Lucky Mellor (5f 2yo), out of 6f 2yo winner; certainly not bred for this trip.
runners.comment: Lot of speed in his pedigree and probably best watched over a trip he's not bred for

runners.name: One Cool County
runners.spotlight: U S Navy Flag half-brother to five winners including Preamble (6f 2yo; RPR 88), Sonoran (7f; 85) and Never Rains (1m; 67); family of Goldikova; nice page but best watched.
runners.comment: U S Navy Flag half-brother to 5 winners, family of Goldikova; well bred but best watched

runners.name: Manntari
runners.spotlight: Sands Of Mali brother to 7.3f winner Sofian, half-brother to four other winners at distances from 7f to 1m6f; dam placed 5f-1m as 2yo.
runners.comment: Sands Of Mali brother to 7.3f winner Sofian, half-brother to four other winners

runners.name: Swing Street
runners.spotlight: Unfancied and trailed throughout when miles behind Camino Lad at Ballinrobe.
runners.comment: Unfancied and trailed throughout when miles behind Camino Lad at Ballinrobe

races.race_name: Heights Hotel, Killarney Handicap

runners.name: Sands Castle
runners.spotlight: Fourth in a Gowran maiden and back to form on second handicap start when staying on to be runner-up to subsequent winner Rodeo Drive at Ballinrobe (9.5f); stayers on dam's side of pedigree, but her best runs have been on easy ground.
runners.comment: Second to subsequent winner Rodeo Drive at Ballinrobe (9.5f); best form on easy ground

runners.name: Chicago Moon
runners.spotlight: Handicapped on AW maiden runs; only beaten 2l over C&D on handicap debut in May; that form is only ordinary, but headgear might help.
runners.comment: Only beaten 2l over C&D on handicap debut in May; ordinary from, but headgear might help
runners.owner: Samuel M Mencoff & Anthony Paul Smurfit

runners.name: Stonyfalls
runners.spotlight: Couple of creditable handicap runs over 7f/1m, placed over latter trip behind easy winner at Bellewstown; big step up in trip; dam won over almost this far in France.
runners.comment: Couple of creditable handicap runs over 7f/1m; big step up in trip

runners.name: Cameclose
runners.spotlight: Travelled well but didn't see it out when beaten 5l in C&D contest in May; his second in Ballinrobe claimer over 9.5f last time is nothing to get too excited about.
runners.comment: Beaten 5l in C&D contest in May; second in Ballinrobe claimer over 9.5f last time

runners.name: No Bother Aoife
runners.spotlight: Finished a head in front of Sir Trancealot when fifth against older horses at Bellewstown (1m4f); that was her best effort in handicaps and might be capable of better.
runners.comment: Finished a head in front of Sir Trancealot when fifth against older horses at Bellewstown

runners.name: Wipeawayyourtears
runners.spotlight: Placed on easy ground in first two handicaps and then handled good ground when winning well over 1m4f at Fairyhouse; Cleary's claim means she's effectively off the same mark.
runners.comment: Handled good ground when winning well over 1m4f at Fairyhouse; claim negates 5lb rise

runners.name: Guildhall Graduate
runners.spotlight: Didn't have the best of runs up the straight when keeping on to fair effect at Fairyhouse (1m4f), but still has fair bit to find with both the winner Wipeawayyourtears and third Sir Trancealot.
runners.comment: Creditable effort at Fairyhouse; fair bit to find with the winner Wipeawayyourtears

runners.name: Cadreville
runners.spotlight: Placed over 9.5f at Gowran; hard to see him reversing Naas 1m3f form with Point Cartwright.
runners.comment: Placed over 9.5f at Gowran; hard to see him reversing Naas 1m3f form with Point Cartwright

runners.name: Canon Law
runners.spotlight: Ran well in a nursery and fair runs behind the same horse, Rodeo Drive, in last two outings; seems safely held by Point Cartwright on latest outing at Naas.
runners.comment: Fair runs behind Rodeo Drive the last twice; held by Point Cartwright on Naas running

runners.name: Point Cartwright
runners.spotlight: Going the right way in handicaps; second over 1m4f at Limerick and looked in need of farther when third to good yardstick Rodeo Blues over this trip at Naas; the long straight here will suit him as he needs time to hit full stride.
runners.comment: Second over 1m4f at Limerick;  third to good yardstick Rodeo Blues over this trip at Naas

runners.name: Polanco
runners.spotlight: Big prices all starts; ran okay over 5f on handicap debut, but well beaten since and going half-a-mile farther today; not bred for this trip either.
runners.comment: Ran okay over 5f on handicap debut, but well beaten since and going half-a-mile farther

runners.name: Flagstone Lady
runners.spotlight: Creditable sixth in Gowran maiden, but dismal run when 9-1 for handicap debut over 9.5f at Ballinrobe; some middle-distance performers in family.
runners.comment: Creditable sixth at Gowran, but dismal run when 9-1 for handicap debut at Ballinrobe

runners.name: Tintinabulla
runners.spotlight: Quiet in maidens; half-sister to a pair of winners over 1mf/1m3f; yard has had a couple run well lately.
runners.comment: Quiet in maidens; half-sister to a pair of winners over 1mf/1m3f; possible improver

runners.name: Sir Trancealot
runners.spotlight: Third to Wipeawayyourtears over 1m4f at Fairyhouse where he battled on well; 7-2 fav for second handicap start over same trip at Bellewstown, faded out of it in the final furlong; cheekpieces swapped for blinkers.
runners.comment: Third to Wipeawayyourtears over 1m4f at Fairyhouse; not so good at at Bellewstown

runners.name: Augusta Rock
runners.spotlight: Only 3-1 for handicap debut at Sligo in May; ran poorly but maybe soft ground was to blame; gelded since and change of headgear; with the stable so powerful in the 3yo category, plenty will afford him another chance.
runners.comment: Only 3-1 for handicap debut at Sligo in May; ran poorly but maybe soft ground was to blame

races.race_name: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Undercover Affair
runners.spotlight: Close third of seven in Nottingham nursery (5f; first-time visor, now discarded) last time; the most exposed contender in this field, as a record of 1-8 reflects (gained the win in seller); however, he's the solid angle, being a consistent sort.
runners.comment: The most exposed contender but he's the solid angle, being a consistent sort

runners.name: Terminology
runners.spotlight: 360,000euros breeze-up purchase who has substance to go with her promise; finished third to smart rival (subsequent Group 2 scorer) on debut and the form of her Lingfield success (5f, good to firm) has received a few boosts; looks likely to do well in nurseries.
runners.comment: Has substance to go with her promise and looks likely to do well in nurseries

runners.name: Jaijai
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced colt who made all for 2l success in five-runner maiden at Goodwood (5f, good) most recently; looks all about speed and warrants respect in another sharp scenario with further improvement plausible.
runners.comment: Made all in 5f Goodwood maiden last time; respected with further progress plausible

races.race_name: Fitzdares Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Asset
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who has consistent 1m/1m2f form and managed to run creditably despite traffic issues at Salisbury most recently, albeit couldn't finish the job once finding a gap; has solid place claims back over 1m.
runners.comment: Thrice-raced filly who has consistent 1m/1m2f form; solid place claims back at 1m
runners.owner: Gestuet Schlenderhan Gmbh U Co Kg

runners.name: Leonardo Blu
runners.spotlight: Showed a plucky attitude to nose ahead in the final strides at Nottingham (1m, good) and build on his debut promise; open to further improvement and warrants respect even with a 5lb penalty.
runners.comment: Showed a plucky attitude to prevail at Nottingham; open to further improvement
runners.owner: J Collins, P Moorhead, C & J Cooley

runners.name: Levens Hall
runners.spotlight: Too Darn Hot gelding who showed abundant promise with fast-finishing third of 12 under 3lb claimer in 1m AW maiden at Southwell; the form has received a couple of boosts and he is open to progress; major player.
runners.comment: Fast-finishing third of 12 in 1m AW maiden at Southwell; open to progress; big player

runners.name: Adalo
runners.spotlight: Seems one for handicaps on the bare form of his two runs; however, may show improvement back down in trip, having seemed a non-stayer over 1m2f at Windsor latest.
runners.comment: Seemed a non-stayer over 1m2f at Windsor last time; may improve back at 1m

runners.name: Esplanade
runners.spotlight: £72,000 yearling; Dark Angel sister to three winners, notably Diabolic (US 5f-6.5f turf/dirt 2yo including Listed); dam Group-placed 5f 2yo winner (97); judged solely on breeding, this newcomer has a doubt over the 1m trip.
runners.comment: £72,000 yearling; pedigree suggests she's not certain to stay the 1m trip

runners.name: Colonnade
runners.spotlight: 45,000euros foal, 135,000gns yearling; Teofilo half-brother to three winners, notably Alashar (Listed-placed 7f/9.5f; RPR 101); dam 6f-1m winner (including Group 3; 112); wears tongue-tie on debut; market instructive.
runners.comment: 135,000gns yearling; by Teofilo; wears tongue-tie on debut; market informative

runners.name: Diane Chasseresse
runners.spotlight: Has something to find on her 7f efforts and therefore needs improvement for this extra furlong; handicaps may be her ideal scene.
runners.comment: Needs improvement for the step up to 1m

runners.name: Next Guilian
runners.spotlight: Placed in sole German start; less solid on his two British efforts and may find better opportunities in handicaps soon.
runners.comment: Not solid on his two British efforts

runners.name: Champagne Beau
runners.spotlight: Always behind in C&D contest having been friendless in the betting; bred to need longer trips.
runners.comment: Always behind in C&D contest and bred to need longer trips

runners.name: Elsa Tan
runners.spotlight: Registered only a meagre RPR in 7f AW maiden at Wolverhampton and is probably one for handicaps later on.
runners.comment: Registered only a meagre RPR in 7f AW maiden

runners.name: Heir Of Ambition
runners.spotlight: Recorded only a modest RPR over C&D last time and needs to take another step forward; may be more interesting in handicaps shortly.
runners.comment: Recorded only a modest RPR over C&D last time

races.race_name: Ambrose Loves Reggae EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)

runners.name: Magi Melchior
runners.spotlight: Showed promise with fourth of ten in Newbury event (6f, good to firm) that saw the only runners with experience filled the first two places; open to progress and is one of the main contenders.
runners.comment: Showed promise with fourth of ten at Newbury; one of the main contenders

runners.name: Sovereigns High
runners.spotlight: Came from further back than the first two in 6f AW maiden at Kempton, finishing third of ten; helps to set the form standard and there is a chance he can show progress to boot.
runners.comment: Placed in 6f AW maiden at Kempton; helps to set the form standard

runners.name: Ferrystream
runners.spotlight: 100,000gns foal, 160,000euros yearling; by Mehmas and first foal of 6f/7f winner (including Group 3; RPR 113); stable's record of 2-8 with 2yos in 2026 includes a successful newcomer this month; interesting.
runners.comment: 160,000euros yearling; by Mehmas; stable had a winning 2yo newcomer this month

runners.name: Mithaaly
runners.spotlight: 72,000gns foal, 260,000gns yearling; Perfect Power half-brother to three winners, notably Chalk Mountain (multiple 7f AW; RPR 91) and Malvern (6f 2yo; 79); dam 5f winner (95); notable connections; respected debutant.
runners.comment: 260,000gns yearling; by Perfect Power; notable connections; respected debutant

runners.name: Artemis Star
runners.spotlight: 18,000gns yearling; Ardad half-brother to four winners, notably Astronomy's Choice (7f 2yo; RPR 96); dam unplaced 1m (57); wears hood on debut; yard is 1-6 with 2yos this term.
runners.comment: 18,000gns yearling; by Ardad; wears hood on debut; yard is 1-6 with 2yos this term

runners.name: Launchpad
runners.spotlight: 3,500euros yearling, 16,000euros breeze-up 2yo; by Space Traveller and first foal of 7f/1m winner (RPR 79); one of several newcomers in the field; market instructive.
runners.comment: 16,000euros breeze-up 2yo; by Space Traveller and first foal of 7f/1m winner

runners.name: Cutlass
runners.spotlight: Both starts over C&D, better effort when running-on fifth of 11 latest; difficult to rule out another step forward but he looks the type who'll be more interesting in nurseries shortly.
runners.comment: Both starts over C&D, better effort when running-on fifth of 11 latest

runners.name: Q T Boy
runners.spotlight: Due Diligence gelded half-brother to 6f 2yo winner Q T Pie (RPR 67), out of 1m2f winner (72); sibling gained the success over C&D, albeit second time out; check the betting.
runners.comment: Due Diligence half-brother to a 2yo C&D winner (second time out)

runners.name: Courage Best
runners.spotlight: Has weak claims on form and is likely to be more at home in modest nurseries shortly.
runners.comment: Weak claims on form

runners.name: Amethyst Star
runners.spotlight: Has plenty to find on Goodwood soft-ground debut and is a similar type to Goodwood Meteor in that she may improve for this quicker surface.
runners.comment: Has plenty to find on her Goodwood soft-ground effort

runners.name: Secret Society
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise with sixth of 11 at Salisbury (6f, soft) despite proving green, losing a shoe and perhaps even finding the ground softer than ideal; interesting with improvement on the cards.
runners.comment: Showed some promise at Salisbury despite proving green and losing a shoe

runners.name: Goodwood Meteor
runners.spotlight: May benefit from the faster surface but needs to improve plenty on his Salisbury soft-ground effort.
runners.comment: Needs to improve plenty on his Salisbury soft-ground effort

races.race_name: Ambrose Loves Reggae EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)

runners.name: Note To Self
runners.spotlight: Twice-raced colt who ran better than the bare result (seventh of nine) suggests at Newbury (6.5f) last time, albeit unable to make his experience count in a race where all of his rivals were newcomers; the form pick in this field.
runners.comment: Ran better than the bare result suggests at Newbury last time; the form pick

runners.name: Real Bullet
runners.spotlight: Mehmas colt; dam 6f AW 2yo winner (RPR 84), out of 7f-winning half-sister to useful winners Kehaar (7f-1m) and All For Laura (5f 2yo; dam of 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Misheer); in good hands; interesting debutant.
runners.comment: Mehmas colt; out of a 6f 2yo winner; in good hands; interesting debutant

runners.name: Kigali
runners.spotlight: May benefit from the return to turf but seems one for nurseries, having finished out of the money in both starts; debut form has admittedly received a few boosts.
runners.comment: Out of the money in both starts; debut form has admittedly received boosts
runners.owner: Mr And Mrs B V Sangster

runners.name: Market Leader
runners.spotlight: 175,000euros foal, 450,000euros (breeze-up) 2yo; Blue Point half-brother to Croupier (7f/1m winner, including 2yo; RPR 108) and two pretty useful winners; dam unraced sister to 7f 2yo Group 2 winner Saamidd; holds a couple of major entries; notable connections; respected newcomer.
runners.comment: 450,000euros (breeze-up) 2yo; by Blue Point; holds two major entries; respected newcomer

runners.name: He's Readytorumble
runners.spotlight: Related to several winners for his connections; never landed a blow in 5f event at Salisbury (finished sixth of nine) but may show improvement upped in distance with the experience under his belt.
runners.comment: May show improvement upped in trip with Salisbury effort under his belt

runners.name: Bossy Angel
runners.spotlight: Has weak claims on form and is likely to be more at home in modest nurseries shortly.
runners.comment: Has weak claims on form

runners.name: Rex Regum
runners.spotlight: Only ninth of 12 in C&D maiden but is evidently thought capable of much better, having been backed into favouritism; one to bear in mind, especially if the money again comes for him.
runners.comment: Only ninth of 12 when favourite for C&D maiden but is evidently thought capable of better

runners.name: Arctic Tsar
runners.spotlight: Only eighth of 11 at Salisbury (6f) but seemed to need the run and looks open to improvement; that race has thrown up a few winners since.
runners.comment: Seemed to need the run in Salisbury race that has thrown up a few winners

runners.name: Bollengo Boy
runners.spotlight: Only eighth of 13 in C&D maiden won by useful sort but appeared to need the outing and may be capable of better.
runners.comment: Appeared to need the outing in C&D maiden won by useful sort

runners.name: Stoney Wood
runners.spotlight: Down the field in both outings and appears to be crying out for an imminent switch to nurseries.
runners.comment: Down the field in both outings

runners.name: Coatimundi
runners.spotlight: Ended up last of ten in Newbury contest (6f) having pulled hard; chance of improvement largely depends on whether he settles better.
runners.comment: Ended up last of ten at Newbury having pulled hard

races.race_name: Fitzdares Sprint Series Handicap (Windsor Sprint Series Qualifier)

runners.name: An Outlaw's Grace
runners.spotlight: Made a successful 2yo debut but he was soon in deep water and his form deteriorated; seen only twice in 2025 but things have stabilised somewhat and he's run two good races over C&D (good to firm), including 16 days ago; not eye-wateringly well handicapped but shouldn't be far away.
runners.comment: Successful 2yo debut; just two runs in 2025; two solid C&D efforts of late; not far away

runners.name: Amazonian Dream
runners.spotlight: Losing turf run goes back over two years but his last three wins on grass have come over C&D, including on good to firm, and he ran another good race on this track two weeks ago; has better claims than many.
runners.comment: Last three turf wins have come over C&D; ran another good race here two weeks ago

runners.name: Kiss And Run
runners.spotlight: 5f winner here; she was involved in tight finishes at Bath (extended 5f; good to soft and heavy) last October and over 5f here in May but more often than not she tends to run out of steam over this trip.
runners.comment: 5f winner here; involved in tight finish here in May; tends to get outstayed at 6f

runners.name: Media Darling
runners.spotlight: Unraced as 2yo but her Newbury debut was promising last term and she followed it with an Ayr maiden win (6f, good to firm); seen only twice more that year, ending with a low-key run in Listed event, and she was beaten a long way at Newmarket on her return from eight months off; however, she showed a glimmer of hope before dropping out and Tom Marquand has his first ride of 2026 for the yard (2-9 in the last five years); trainer won this in 2024.
runners.comment: Promising 3yo at 6f; dropped out on return from 8 months off but can do better here

runners.name: Hayynah
runners.spotlight: Has run well over C&D in maiden and novice events but her win came over 5f on Southwell AW and she has yet to cut the mustard in handicaps; her mark is sliding slowly but she needs more for the win.
runners.comment: Has C&D form but sole win came over 5f on AW; has not yet cut the mustard in handicaps

runners.name: Under The Twilight
runners.spotlight: Has a record of 2-7 over C&D (both wins on good to firm) and although not in quite the same form this year as she was last summer, such as when going close off 13lb higher on this track, she wasn't far away back here two starts ago; no surprise to see her go well.
runners.comment: Record of 2-7 over C&D; close up back here two starts ago; can go well again

runners.name: Papa Cocktail
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner but turf successes are thin on the ground now, just one in over three years; however, he's been running up to his best since back on grass, going down narrowly in a higher grade at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) in May and another solid effort there last time; thereabouts.
runners.comment: Multiple wins but just one on turf in over three years; in form though and thereabouts

runners.name: Slay Queen
runners.spotlight: Made all/most to take two 6f races last August/September (on good and heavy) but this year has got off to a terrible start with crushing defeats at Newmarket and Chester; risky for now; yard also runs An Outlaw's Grace.
runners.comment: Made all/most to take two 6f races as 2yo; two crushing defeats this year; risky

runners.name: Bintola
runners.spotlight: Hooded in three juvenile starts but not as 3yo, returning with a quite convincing win on handicap debut over C&D (good to firm) from one who won either side of that race; unable to improve on that at Newmarket next time when 7lb higher but she was tight for room at one stage and still has potential.
runners.comment: Ready winner of handicap debut (C&D); no progress off 7lb higher after; may still improve

runners.name: Sir Alfie
runners.spotlight: Two sprint wins in Ireland as 2yo, including when making all at the Curragh (6f, good) last August, but  in poor form on turf and the AW in Britain this year and it's hard to believe he's worth his current mark.
runners.comment: Two sprint wins as 2yo in Ireland; in poor form in Britain  and not worth his current mark

runners.name: Tanmawwy
runners.spotlight: Win haul includes two C&D wins but he missed all of 2025, was beaten a long way on his return from an absence and then failed to finish at Newbury in June; has it all to prove with refitted blinkers added to regular hood.
runners.comment: Two C&D wins; missed all of 2025; beaten a long way then pulled up in two runs this year

runners.name: Jax Edge
runners.spotlight: Majority of her turf wins have come at Bath and Chepstow, most recently when making all on the former track in June, but she's a C&D winner too (good to firm) and she lost her chance early when back on this course 16 days ago; on a career-high mark but not ruled out.
runners.comment: C&D winner; made all at Bath in June; excuse since; career-high mark now

races.race_name: Find Us At fitzdares.com Handicap

runners.name: Tribal Rhythm
runners.spotlight: Seems best when fresh and duly ran well (close second) at Bath on seasonal debut; appeared to be a disappointing favourite at Epsom later in April but that effort is excusable with the race likely coming sooner than ideal; only attempt under Tom Marquand resulted in sole win (off current mark to boot); respected on return from 11-week break.
runners.comment: Seems best when fresh; on a handy mark; respected on return from 11-week break

runners.name: Kalokalo
runners.spotlight: Steadily progressive colt who has form figures of 21423121 (turf/AW) since handicapping; comfortably justified favouritism dropped back to 1m at Southwell eight days ago; 1-1 at Windsor (1m2f win) and holds solid claims under a 6lb penalty returned to this course.
runners.comment: Steadily progressive colt who has form figures of 21423121 in handicaps; solid

runners.name: Knowledge
runners.spotlight: Raced only four times, winning 1m AW event then failing to progress over 1m2f on turf; beaten long way last time and needs to derive major benefit from this drop back in trip, combined with first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Needs to derive major benefit from the drop back to 1m, combined with headgear

runners.name: Cristo
runners.spotlight: Prevailed by a neck at Sandown (1m, good) last time, registering a first success on turf; back up 3lb but remains well treated on the pick of his AW form; gained his other wins back-to-back.
runners.comment: Prevailed by neck at Sandown last time; remains well treated on best AW form

runners.name: Candonomore
runners.spotlight: Successful for two previous yards and ran creditably at Ayr on debut for current stable; below par in two starts since but likely found 6f too sharp latest; returns to a more suitable distance.
runners.comment: Returns to a more suitable distance, having likely found 6f too sharp last time

runners.name: Bold Impact
runners.spotlight: Novice winner for previous yard; 0-6 for current stable but ran encouragingly, despite being left with plenty to do, in last two starts; caught the attention of the stewards at Ffos Las (1m) latest; interesting with Oisin Murphy up for first time, assuming the cards drop right.
runners.comment: Ran encouragingly, despite being left with plenty to do, in last two starts

runners.name: Newfangled
runners.spotlight: Has a better strike-rate on AW than turf and remains on a career-high mark, so seems up against it; however, consistent record (12233) at Windsor includes a good effort (neck second) in this contest last year; solid contender back here.
runners.comment: Solid record (12233) at Windsor includes a good effort in this race last year

runners.name: Mollie Foster
runners.spotlight: Made a successful AW debut on final start for previous yard but has failed to back up the form kept to that sphere for new connections; returns from a layoff and reverts to turf; follow the market signals.
runners.comment: Scored on AW debut; below form kept to that sphere for new connections since

races.race_name: Download The Fitzdares App Now Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Silent City
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage filly whose solid record features two wins over 1m, including at Windsor; finished nicely for third at Newmarket on seasonal debut and looks ready for a crack at tonight's longer distance; remains open to further progress; highly respected.
runners.comment: Low-mileage filly; solid record and remains open to further progress; highly respected

runners.name: Morcar
runners.spotlight: Prevailed narrowly at Newbury last time, taking record to 5-28 and confirming that he's well suited by fast ground; back up 3lb but remains well handicapped on peak form and is a dual C&D winner; good third in this race last year; one of the main players.
runners.comment: Prevailed narrowly at Newbury last time; still well treated on peak form; dual C&D winner

runners.name: A Major Payne
runners.spotlight: Record is only 1-19 but the success, at Nottingham, is among his recent form and puts him 1-1 under Oisin Murphy; ran creditably a few days later and remains a consistent sort; rested over five weeks since that last run; solid claims.
runners.comment: Sole success is among his recent form and puts him 1-1 under Oisin Murphy; consistent

runners.name: Shady Bay
runners.spotlight: Creditable third in both starts since making a successful reappearance; remains in form but is getting no respite from the assessor, as another 1lb rise reflects; has done all her winning off marks in the 60s.
runners.comment: Remains in form but is getting no respite from the assessor; raised a further 1lb
runners.owner: P Afia, E Hobson, A Pegley, C&r Russell

runners.name: Special Ghaiyyath
runners.spotlight: Successful for two previous yards but holds weak claims on his efforts for current stable; campaigned mostly at about 1m and has enough to prove back up in trip; blinkers replace the cheekpieces worn last time.
runners.comment: Holds weak claims on his efforts for current stable; enough to prove back up in trip

runners.name: Eupator
runners.spotlight: Has gained both wins on AW but that was the case with stablemate Cristo (declared 7:50) until he recently prevailed on turf; has posted inconsistent results since returned to this sphere, however, and isn't a solid option.
runners.comment: Has gained both wins on AW; inconsistent results since returned to turf
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing I and Partner

runners.name: Pomme Pomme
runners.spotlight: Commenced handicap career with a five-timer but a record of 0-4 since reflects that her ceiling has likely been reached; sole effort this term (folded tamely, well beaten) leaves a question mark over her current form.
runners.comment: Sole effort this term (well beaten) leaves a question mark over her current form

races.race_name: Fitzdares Handicap

runners.name: Lady Milton
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner (1m-1m2f) who returned to turf with creditable third in competitive Sandown handicap (1m, good) last month; competes off same mark here and could still have untapped potential over this longer trip; good chance.
runners.comment: Three-time AW winner; third in competitive Sandown handicap when back on turf; good chance

runners.name: Bintsaleh
runners.spotlight: Absent since safely held in Sandown novice in April but made promising seasonal debut when third at Yarmouth (also 1m2f, good) a fortnight earlier and this well-bred filly is open to considerable improvement in handicaps.
runners.comment: Third in Yarmouth novice in April; this well-bred filly can improve in handicaps

runners.name: Darn Hot Dame
runners.spotlight: Slightly disappointing when well-held fourth at Goodwood (1m4f, good) last month but held on gamely to make winning turf debut here (11.4f, good to firm) in May and might still have a bit more to offer if combination of drop back in trip and first-time cheekpieces aids her cause.
runners.comment: Made winning turf debut here (11.4f) in May; not quite in same form last time; headgear on

runners.name: Shadow Brigade
