runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden who was placed at Kempton (7f, AW) last summer; made little impact over that C&D on recent seasonal reappearance but this hike up in trip is an interesting move for her handicap debut, and the booking of Oisin Murphy adds further intrigue.
runners.comment: Upped from 7f for handicap debut and Oisin Murphy is booked; interesting

runners.name: Impossible Mission
runners.spotlight: Yet to make any significant further progress since winning nursery debut at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) in November but recent third of five here (11.4f, good to firm) was perfectly respectable and he may benefit from this drop back in trip.
runners.comment: Not progressing this year but his recent third of five here was perfectly respectable

races.race_name: Download The At The Races App Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Lord Ragnar
runners.spotlight: Left his debut form well behind when runner-up at Leicester (7f, good) last month and he took another step forward when scoring at Newcastle (7f, AW) 18 days ago; rallied well to beat a clear second in that race and he's open to more progress now switched to a nursery; respected.
runners.comment: Won a Newcastle maiden (7f) latest and he's open to more progress on nursery debut
runners.owner: Sarah Fern, Patricia James And Partner

runners.name: Greek Symphony
runners.spotlight: Did best of the newcomers when an encouraging third on her Goodwood debut (6f, soft) last month; 5-2 for a fast-ground Newbury novice 11 days later and she went down fighting in a close second of ten; looks on a fair mark now switched to a nursery and she's an interesting contender at this new trip.
runners.comment: Went close at Newbury and she's an interesting contender upped in trip on nursery debut

runners.name: Dei Gratia Regina
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in three novice events, most recently when runner-up over an extended 7f at Beverley (good to firm) in May; should have a future in handicaps but opening mark is no gift and she needs to find more after a short break.
runners.comment: Showed promise in novice events but she needs to find more to defy this opening mark

runners.name: Crazy Cubana
runners.spotlight: 120,000gns yearling; looked in trouble at the halfway stage at Nottingham (6f, good) in May but she finished well to snatch an unlikely victory at 12-1; found things tough in the Albany at Royal Ascot but she's back in calmer waters here and is open to progress on this step up to 7f; not ruled out on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Won on Nottingham debut before a tough task in the Albany; not ruled out on nursery debut

runners.name: King Of Montenegro
runners.spotlight: Finished down the field in his first two runs but he found improvement when runner-up in a Windsor maiden (6f, good to firm) in May; needs to build on that but he should have more to offer and his dam was a 7f winner as a 2yo.
runners.comment: Improved form when second at Windsor (6f) and has claims if he can build on that

races.race_name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap

runners.name: Educator
runners.spotlight: His last win was 14 months ago but he made some good late headway when runner-up at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) last month; only 1lb higher here and he looks interesting back up in trip.
runners.comment: His last win was 14 months ago but he finished second at Windsor latest; in the mix

runners.name: Expressionless
runners.spotlight: In and out since winning at Leicester (1m4f, good) in April and he was beaten 8l after a slow start at Newbury last time; now only 1lb higher than for that last success but he needs to raise his game back up in trip.
runners.comment: On dangerous mark but he needs to raise his game back up in trip

runners.name: Further Measure
runners.spotlight: Nine of his ten wins have come on AW and he's a strong stayer at up to 2m; his last win was off this mark at Kempton in February but he flopped at that track last month and needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Nine-time AW winner but he flopped at Kempton last month and needs to bounce back

runners.name: Senor Cortez
runners.spotlight: Has a patchy record but he turned things around with an 5l win over 1m6f at Southwell (AW; 7-4 favourite) last Sunday; looks well treated under a penalty for that success and his penultimate win was at this track; strong contender.
runners.comment: Easy winner at Southwell last Sunday and he looks well treated under penalty; big player

runners.name: Mister Daydream
runners.spotlight: Dual turf winner at 1m2f and 1m3f for Charlie Johnston last spring; has had some struggles since but he got back to form with a bang when winning by 7l here (1m4f, AW) last Monday; that was off a tumbling mark and he's a major player if he can repeat that form under a penalty.
runners.comment: Back to form with a bang when winning by 7l here last week; key player under penalty

runners.name: Naasma
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner, with four at Windsor (11.4f) and two on Polytrack (1m2f/2m); her last success was off 2lb higher last autumn but she's been disappointing in last two runs and needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Six-time winner but she's been out of sorts in last two runs; needs to get back on track

runners.name: Big Bear Hug
runners.spotlight: Her first four wins were on turf but she made the breakthrough on AW when finishing well to land an apprentice handicap at Kempton (1m3f) last Wednesday; now steps back up in trip but she beat an odds-on rival last time and escapes a penalty for that success; dangerous.
runners.comment: Escapes a penalty for her Kempton win and she's respected back up in trip

runners.name: Crackergee
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough at the 12th attempt when justifying support at Ffos Las (1m4f, good to soft) last month; 4lb higher in different conditions here but he pulled well clear with the runner-up last time and his best form has come on Polytrack; respected back up in trip.
runners.comment: Pulled well clear with the runner-up when scoring at Ffos Las (1m4f); respected up 4lb

runners.name: Percy Jones
runners.spotlight: All four wins have been at Wolverhampton (1m4f-2m) and latest was 11 months ago; finished a close third off 1lb higher at Bath (1m6f, good) last month but he's not easy to predict and was well held with cheekpieces tried at Chester last time; the headgear is quickly discarded but he comes with risks attached.
runners.comment: On workable mark but he's not easy to predict and was well held last time; risks attached

runners.name: Love Is Golden
runners.spotlight: Well treated on his old form for the Johnstons but he returned after a mammoth absence last month and has been tailed off at big prices in both runs (1m4f/2m) for current yard; lots to prove.
runners.comment: Back from mammoth absence last month and he's been tailed off in both runs for new yard

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C-D) (EBF Restricted Race Qual') (GBB)

runners.name: Aphra Behn
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to French winners Sandon (1m2f 2yo) and Betty Nelson (10.5f); made a promising start when a clear third at Salisbury (6f, soft) and she built on that with a near-miss over 7f at Newcastle (AW) 18 days ago; sets the standard on that form and she's open to more progress; strong contender.
runners.comment: Had a near-miss when upped to 7f at Newcastle (AW) and she's a strong contender

runners.name: Ardad Steve
runners.spotlight: Ran into some trouble before keeping on well when fourth on Yarmouth debut (6f, good) in May; never-dangerous sixth in the Woodcote at Epsom last month but that was a respectable effort from a wide draw and he's open to progress on this step up in trip; in the mix for in-form yard.
runners.comment: Two promising efforts and latest was in the Woodcote at Epsom; respected upped in trip

runners.name: Norfolk Dream
runners.spotlight: 36,000gns foal, 27,000gns yearling; second foal; dam unraced half-sister to useful winners Tannaaf (7f 2yo/1m2f), Danjeu (1m4f) and Waheebah (10.5f-1m6f), out of 1m4f winner; yard 4-10 with 2yos this season and she needs a close look on debut.
runners.comment: 27,000gns yearling; yard 4-10 with 2yos this season and she needs a close look on debut

runners.name: Cracking Idea
runners.spotlight: 15,000euros foal, 27,000gns yearling; third foal; half-brother to Italian winners Sayidah Poets (7.5f/1m 2yo) and Siguanaba (6f-1m including 2yo); dam maiden (third 10.5f in France) sister to useful 7f/1m winner Brave Hero, half-sister to US 1m stakes winner Double Touch; yard 1-7 with 2yos this year and market should guide on debut.
runners.comment: Half-brother to two 2yo winners and market should guide on debut

runners.name: Beningbrough Hall
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to winners Rydale Frosty (6f 2yo; RPR 94), City Of York (1m/1m1f including AW; 87), Thorntonledale Max (7f AW; 76) and Dalby Forest (5f AW; 71); dam 5f/6f winner (including 2yo/AW; 104), out of multiple 5f winner; only the third 2yo runner for yard this year but he needs watching in market.
runners.comment: Half-brother to four winners and he needs watching in market on debut

runners.name: Gravastar
runners.spotlight: RPR of 46 when well held in 6f events at Goodwood (soft) and Newbury (good to firm); has a lot to find upped in trip and nurseries will be more suitable.
runners.comment: RPRs of 46 in both runs so far and nurseries will be more suitable

runners.name: Deira Moon
runners.spotlight: 19,000euros foal, 24,000euros yearling; half-brother to 1m/1m3f winner Lennox (including AW/Australia; RPR 83); dam 13.3f AW winner (82), half-sister to winners James Garfield (6f 2yo Group 2) and Hallelujah U (useful 1m 2yo/1m4f); drawn out wide on debut and he could be one for later on.
runners.comment: 24,000euros yearling; drawn out wide on debut and he could be one for later on

runners.name: Quest For Glory
runners.spotlight: Gelded son of Sea The Moon; 20-1 and he ran green throughout when a well-held fourth at Kempton (7f, AW) two weeks ago; should know more this time but he needs a major step forward on his second start.
runners.comment: Well-held fourth at Kempton two weeks ago and he needs a major step forward here

runners.name: Nakila Sun
runners.spotlight: 8,000euros yearling; out of a sister to a 7f Group 3 juvenile winner in Germany but he made a low-key start when sixth of eight here (7f, good to firm) in May; should be more streetwise this time but he needs to leave that debut form well behind.
runners.comment: Made a low-key start here in May and he needs to leave that form well behind

runners.name: Crown Velocity
runners.spotlight: Out of an unraced half-sister to 7f Group 3 winner Dandhu; showed only minor promise when eighth of 13 at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) last month and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Only minor promise when eighth of 13 at Yarmouth last month and others are preferred

runners.name: Cool King
runners.spotlight: £25,000 breeze-up 2yo; 100-30 favourite on Wolverhampton debut (6f, AW) last month but he ran green before finishing a well-held seventh of ten; should know more this time but he needs a transformation upped in trip.
runners.comment: Disappointing favourite at Wolverhampton and he needs a transformation upped in trip

runners.name: Taseem
runners.spotlight: Tailed off at big prices in his three runs and latest was over this trip at Kempton (AW); hood is now added but he can only be watched.
runners.comment: Tailed off at big prices in all three runs and latest was over this trip; hood added

races.race_name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap

runners.name: Split Elevens
runners.spotlight: Recorded his 11th AW win when scoring at Wolverhampton (7f) in May; good second over C&D next time and he had a wide trip when a respectable fourth back at Wolverhampton 11 days ago; should get a good tow into this race and he's respected back on Polytrack.
runners.comment: 11-time AW winner who has been in good form this spring; respected back on Polytrack

runners.name: Kyoto
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who has finished a well-held fifth in two 6f handicaps (AW/soft) but it's still early days and he's a possible improver at this new trip; one to keep an eye on.
runners.comment: Unexposed 4yo and he's a possible improver at this new trip; one to keep an eye on

runners.name: Rosemary's Rose
runners.spotlight: Two 1m wins on Polytrack this spring, in a Lingfield classified event and a Kempton handicap; finished runner-up three times since her last success including at Wolverhampton (7f) and Ffos Las (1m) in last two runs; up another 2lb but she still looks feasibly treated and has leading claims.
runners.comment: In-form 4yo who won twice in the spring and has finished runner-up last twice; big player

runners.name: The Dark Baron
runners.spotlight: Turf and dual Tapeta winner who justified favouritism with a narrow success at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) in March; still looks feasibly treated on that form but he flopped at Bath (1m, firm) last time and needs to bounce back after that heavy defeat.
runners.comment: On workable mark but he needs to bounce back after a heavy defeat at Bath last time

runners.name: Equion
runners.spotlight: Triple turf winner who is 1-19 on AW; perked up with a close call at Wolverhampton (8.6f) in December but he's not come close to that form in three subsequent runs; may have needed his Nottingham reappearance last month but his tactical speed will be tested back at this trip and others are more convincing.
runners.comment: Triple turf winner who is 1-19 on AW and others are more convincing

runners.name: Dannick
runners.spotlight: 16-race maiden but he was runner-up three times last season and wasn't beaten far when fifth in new headgear at Kempton (6f, AW) 11 days ago; that was eye-catching from off the pace and he's in the mix back up in trip.
runners.comment: 0-16 but he's on a reduced mark and was an eye-catcher over 6f latest; dangerous

runners.name: Bonnita
runners.spotlight: Defied this mark at Salisbury (6f, heavy) last September but she's had only two runs since and has struggled in both of them; still unexposed on AW but she needs a major revival on her second run after break.
runners.comment: Won at Salisbury last autumn but she's struggled in both runs since; needs major revival
runners.owner: G E Bassett & P R Chamings

runners.name: Pickering Castle
runners.spotlight: Looks interesting on some runner-up efforts (6f/7f) last summer but he was quiet during the winter including over 7f on Polytrack; record is now 0-12 and he has something to prove after 155 days off.
runners.comment: Record of 0-12 and he has something to prove after 155 days off

runners.name: Havana Sky
runners.spotlight: Seven-time AW winner and his last success was over 6f here last October; now 2lb lower than for that win but has a mixed record since and was never involved at Wolverhampton last Monday; comes with risks attached and he needs to raise his game back up in trip; cheekpieces reapplied.
runners.comment: On dangerous mark but he's not easy to predict and comes with risks attached

runners.name: Dashing Donkey
runners.spotlight: Four-time turf winner who is 0-10 on AW but he gave it a good shot from the front when fourth over C&D last month; 1lb lower now and has possibilities if he can build on that last run.
runners.comment: 0-10 on AW but was a front-running fourth over C&D last month; not ruled out

runners.name: The Organiser
runners.spotlight: Can miss the break but he's on a dangerous mark and was runner-up here (7f, good) in May before a respectable fourth at Chepstow last month; this return to AW is no problem and he has each-way claims.
runners.comment: Fair efforts on turf in last two starts and has claims if he gets the breaks back on AW

runners.name: Hour By Hour
runners.spotlight: All wins at 6f on ground ranging from good to soft to heavy, the last three in 2024; well handicapped on his old form but he's been tailed off in three runs (1m, AW/good to firm) for new yard this year and has a lot to prove
runners.comment: Tailed off in three runs for new yard this year and he has a lot to prove

runners.name: Majestic Wave
runners.spotlight: Won 6f maiden at Navan as 2yo; promising stable debut over 6f on this track in February 2025 but he's mostly struggled since; now 27lb below his peak mark but he was laboured over C&D last time and others are preferred.
runners.comment: On much-reduced mark but he was laboured over C&D last time and is now 1-17

runners.name: Dancing Terror
runners.spotlight: First and second in two C&D novices the winter before last but, having been off for a year, he's trailed home last in three handicaps in 2026; still unexposed but he has plenty to prove for new yard (left Amanda Perrett for 1,200gns).
runners.comment: C&D novice winner but he's finished last in three handicaps; lots to prove for new yard

races.race_name: Follow @attheraces On X Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Court Drive
runners.spotlight: Scored off reduced mark at Yarmouth (6f, soft) last month and also ran well when third at Newmarket (5f, good) ten days later; suited by his C&D and can make her presence felt again.
runners.comment: Back in good form on turf last month and this C&D also suits; respected

runners.name: Autumn Affair
runners.spotlight: Flopped badly when odds-on at Wolverhampton (7f) in May and now has a point to prove but scored over C&D on handicap debut in March and could still have a lot more to offer if back on song.
runners.comment: Flopped badly last time but won over C&D on handicap debut; still has potential

runners.name: Sydney Rock
runners.spotlight: Runner-up over 7f on all three 2yo starts but was last of ten when upped to 1m for last month's seasonal/handicap debut; tries sprinting with a tongue-tie added today; not an easy one to weigh up at the moment.
runners.comment: Second over 7f on all three 2yo starts but came last when upped to 1m for seasonal return

runners.name: Havana Halo
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden who ended last season with a disappointing 7f run and made a low-key return over that trip last month; might have needed that recent outing but others in this line-up have much less to prove.
runners.comment: Ended last season with a disappointing run and made a low-key return last month

runners.name: Perfect Location
runners.spotlight: Seemed to benefit from combination of drop back in trip and new cheekpieces when scoring at Goodwood (6f, soft) last month; recent 5lb rise asks quite a lot of her but this return to Polytrack won't be a problem.
runners.comment: Won on soft-turf in new cheekpieces last month; up 5lb but Polytrack also suits
runners.owner: Mildmay Racing Pl & Only Fillies Rc

runners.name: Zooella
runners.spotlight: Showed similar level of fair form on all four 2yo starts, most recently when fourth on nursery debut at Chelmsford (7f) in December; might have more to offer back at 6f this year but has fitness to prove after seven-month break.
runners.comment: Showed similar level of fair form on all four 2yo starts; back from seven-month break

runners.name: Pilgrim's Progress
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who displayed improvement when close second in 5f novice here in December; makes handicap debut after seven-month absence but solid market support will bring her into the equation.
runners.comment: Close second in 5f novice here in December; makes handicap debut after seven-month break

runners.name: Night Shining
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who kept on for fourth when dropped back to 6f for recent handicap debut at Kempton; needs to build on that performance here but has the potential if aided by new tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Kept on for fourth on recent handicap debut; a possible if aided by new tongue-tie

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Classified Stakes (Div I)

runners.name: Love You More
runners.spotlight: 0-13 but she went close at Nottingham (8.3f, good) in April and wasn't beaten far after missing the break in a Windsor handicap (1m, good to firm) last month; has claims if things go more to plan this time and she's respected back on AW.
runners.comment: 0-13 but she wasn't beaten far after missing the break at Windsor latest; dangerous

runners.name: Celtic John
runners.spotlight: Won a classified event over C&D in January but he's not hit the same level since and was out the back at Brighton (1m2f) last month; now drops back in trip but he's not easy to predict and overall record is 1-18; others are more convincing.
runners.comment: C&D winner but overall record is 1-18 and others are more convincing

runners.name: Monks Mead
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner who was placed on turf here (1m2f) last month but he flopped on his drop back to 1m at Bath (started slowly) 12 days ago; needs to bounce back after that and he's probably more potent over longer trips these days.
runners.comment: Plenty of good efforts this year but he flopped when dropped back to 1m last time

runners.name: Manton Road
runners.spotlight: In-form 4yo who has been placed at Wolverhampton (8.6f) in his last two starts including when runner-up in a handicap last Monday; usually comes from off the pace and has claims if he gets the breaks.
runners.comment: In-form 4yo who has been placed at Wolverhampton in his last two runs; shortlisted

runners.name: Raqraaq
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come over C&D but latest was in January 2025; finished third over 7f here in March but he's struggled in both subsequent runs and others are preferred.
runners.comment: His last win was 18 months ago and he's struggled in his last two runs; others preferred

runners.name: Nutcracker
runners.spotlight: Went close at Wolverhampton (8.6f) and Chepstow (1m) before getting off the mark (13th attempt) in a classified event at Wolverhampton last Tuesday; pulled 5l clear with his main market rival in that race and he hit a personal best with that brave success; key player.
runners.comment: Off the mark when beating a clear second in classified at Wolverhampton latest; key player

runners.name: Fitzmaurice
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden who has been struggling to get competitive this year and has been well held in both runs for current yard; down the list.
runners.comment: 12-race maiden who has been struggling to get competitive this year; opposable

runners.name: Elenaya
runners.spotlight: Disappointing favourite on debut last May and she's finished tailed off again in both subsequent runs; now drops into a 0-50 event but she needs a transformation back on AW.
runners.comment: Unexposed 3yo but she's been tailed off in all three runs; lots to prove

runners.name: Keeper Of Secrets
runners.spotlight: Two respectable efforts on AW (1m2f/9.4f) this year but he struggled in a classified event here (1m4f) when last seen in March; gelded since but he's now 0-9 and needs a major revival back in trip after a break.
runners.comment: Nine-race maiden who needs a major revival back at 1m after a break; has been gelded

runners.name: Querida Zarah
runners.spotlight: Beaten 14l or more in three novice events (6f/7f) last season, with a best RPR of 29; now switches to a classified event but she needs lots of improvement upped to 1m on her return.
runners.comment: Struggled in novice events and she needs lots of improvement on this step up to 1m

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Classified Stakes (Div II)

runners.name: Masqool
runners.spotlight: 11-time AW winner including four at this track (7f/1m2f); has a patchy record this year but he came from the rear to finish runner-up in a classified event at Wolverhampton (8.6f) last Tuesday; should get a decent tow into this race and he's respected back on Polytrack.
runners.comment: 11-time AW winner who was runner-up at Wolverhampton (8.6f) last week; respected

runners.name: Freedom Bay
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 13th attempt when landing a Bath handicap (1m, good) last month; that was a surprise at 33-1 but she responded well to new equipment and hit a personal best with that comfortable success; big player again if she can back that up.
runners.comment: Off the mark with a clearcut win at Bath (33-1); big player again if she can back that up

runners.name: Rainbow Sign
runners.spotlight: Just three wins from 64 starts but he returned after a short break with a near-miss in a classified at Brighton (7f, good) last month; has possibilities back up in trip and his first two wins came on AW at Lingfield.
runners.comment: Just three wins from 64 starts but he had a near-miss at Brighton last time; shortlisted

runners.name: Henfield
runners.spotlight: 3yo filly who posted a better effort with cheekpieces added when runner-up in a C&D handicap last Monday; was beaten around 4l in that race but she's still unexposed and has claims if she can build on that.
runners.comment: Unexposed filly who was runner-up in a C&D handicap last Monday; each-way claims

runners.name: Miss Gold
runners.spotlight: Struggled in maiden/novice events including two tailed-off efforts at massive prices this summer; now drops into a 0-50 event but she needs a transformation at this new trip.
runners.comment: Struggled in maiden/novice events and she needs a transformation dropped into a classified

runners.name: Conquest Of Power
runners.spotlight: Five-time AW winner including over C&D; his last success was 17 months ago but he returned after a short break with an eye-catching fourth in a Wolverhampton handicap (6f, Tapeta) last week; didn't get much luck in that race and he's in the mix back up in trip; visor reapplied.
runners.comment: Five-time AW winner who was an eye-catching fourth at Wolverhampton last week; dangerous

runners.name: Turpin
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden who has yet to be placed and he was tailed off in an Epsom handicap (1m2f, good) 12 days ago; visor is now added and he needs a major revival back in trip.
runners.comment: Ten-race maiden who was tailed off at Epsom latest; visor is now added back in trip

runners.name: Zaltalla
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f handicap here (AW) for Michael Attwater last summer but that is his sole win from 26 starts and he's generally struggled since; comes with risks attached after 165 days off but he needs checking in market for new yard.
runners.comment: Returns after 165 days off but he needs checking in market for new yard

runners.name: Launceston
runners.spotlight: 15-race maiden who has been out of sorts over hurdles and on the Flat this year; hasn't been with Tony Carroll for long but he was beaten 8l in a classified event at Brighton (1m2f) last week and others are preferred; stablemate of Masqool.
runners.comment: 15-race maiden and he was beaten 8l in a classified event (1m2f) on recent stable debut

races.race_name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Classified Stakes

runners.name: Belle Of Kt
runners.spotlight: Beaten 19l at Ffos Las (1m2f) three weeks ago but won in this grade at Wolverhampton (1m4f) in March and was placed on turf here (1m2f) two starts ago; a possible if back on song.
runners.comment: Well beaten on turf last month but won in this grade at Wolverhampton in March; a possible

runners.name: Graffiti
runners.spotlight: Not the force of old but darted clear for convincing success when dropped to this grade at Brighton (1m2f, good to firm) on Tuesday and should also be suited by today's trip-and-surface combination; commands respect under 4lb penalty.
runners.comment: Darted clear for convincing success when dropped to this grade at Brighton on Tuesday

runners.name: Charles Morin
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on latest Flat start in May (2m, turf) but has been placed in two AW handicaps here this year (1m4f/2m) and didn't run badly over hurdles last month; swaps cheekpieces for first-time visor; more appealing than most.
runners.comment: Placed in two AW handicaps here this year (1m4f/2m) and ran okay over hurdles last month

runners.name: Douglas Dc
runners.spotlight: Has 1-54 career strike-rate, the win gained over hurdles in 2022; this year's Flat handicap form is uninspiring but he'll appreciate this ease in grade and is worth a glance in the betting.
runners.comment: This year's handicap form is uninspiring but he's worth a market check in this lower grade

runners.name: Smoker Bellamy
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden; second in Wolverhampton handicap (9.4f) on seasonal debut in April and put two lesser efforts behind him when sixth there (8.6f) last month but needs to find something extra over this new trip; wore blinkers or cheekpieces for last five races but goes without headgear today.
runners.comment: Ran okay on two of four starts this year but needs to find extra over this new trip

runners.name: Pablo Prince
runners.spotlight: Struggled on turf 12 days ago and remains without a win since September 2024 but this C&D suits him well and the pick of this year's form gives him each-way claims.
runners.comment: No win since September 2024 but this C&D suits him well; considered each-way

runners.name: Sapphire Dream
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden who started off for new stable with two respectable runs; no match for easy winner when second in C&D selling handicap a week ago but has each-way claims again.
runners.comment: No match for winner when second in recent C&D selling handicap but has e-w claims again

runners.name: Make It Up
runners.spotlight: Launched handicap career with two thirds off basment mark in April (9.4f/1m4f) and didn't run badly when fifth of eigth at Wolverhampton (1m4f) last month but needs to take a step forward to get a win on the board.
runners.comment: Ran fairly well in all three handicaps but needs to take a step forward to open account.

runners.name: Blue Birdie
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten all four starts, most recently when 80-1 outsider in this grade at Ffos Las (1m2f, good) three weeks ago; needs first-time cheekpieces to have miraculous effect.
runners.comment: Yet to show any promise after four runs; needs huge boost from new cheekpieces

runners.name: Hawaiian King
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in 1m Kempton handicap on Wednesday and now 0-12; unexposed over 1m4f but it's questionable whether the refitted cheekpieces will make much difference, and he remains difficult to enthuse over.
runners.comment: 12-race maiden who was soundly beaten in a recent Kempton handicap; not the obvious answer
runners.owner: Aura Racing, Dave Brown, Joe Lane

runners.name: Lilykoy
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden; looked suited by big hike up in trip when staying-on fifth of 13 in this grade at Windsor (11.4f, good to soft; first-time cheekpieces) on last month's seasonal debut but suffered heavy defeat in 1m4f Epsom handicap 12 days ago; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Ran quite well in this grade on seasonal debut but well beaten in a handicap since

runners.name: Mister Pretentious
runners.spotlight: Unexposed after only four runs but was in rear throughout and beaten over 15l when upped to 11.6f and fitted with cheekpieces (retained) for handicap debut here (turf) in May.
runners.comment: In rear throughout when upped to 11.6f for handicap debut in May

runners.name: Brave Guest
runners.spotlight: Didn't show a great deal on the Flat for Jack Channon last year (unplaced all six runs) but came second in two juvenile hurdles for new stable in December; absent since January but still looks quite interesting in this basement grade on Flat return.
runners.comment: Second in two juvenile hurdles in December; quite interesting in this grade on Flat return

runners.name: Alex The Great
runners.spotlight: Regressive 6yo who has not run on the Flat since midfield finish in 1m6f Wolverhampton handicap in April; ran okay in two handicap hurdles last month but others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Ran okay in two handicap hurdles last month but others have more pressing claims
